summary: Working with the running game through XF's bridge: facts read with their age, commands paced, writes audited and reversible.

steps.does: The game writes its session file; replies and captures arrive by reference.
Connects while something demands game facts or a scripted session runs.
Records the session, its process and pacing.
Runs each command at up to 18 a second in bursts of 36.
Compares game facts (with their age) to the Studio's values.
Shows disagreements with Push to the game and Adopt.
Records each write's reversal note before sending it.

demand: Any node consuming game facts; a scripted session's run.

faults.when: No game with XF's bridge is running.
The bridge refuses for pacing; retried within 4 s.

latency: 18 requests a second; commands never block the interface.
game.wait is a long-running process with a signal.
budget.memory: Captures by reference; the pipe lingers briefly after its last consumer.

invariants: Every write is audited with its reversal note before it is sent.
A stale game fact shows as a disagreement with its age, never as an error.
A new session ID reconnects; nothing is sent to an old session.

x-friction.gap: Pacing, retries and ages on observations.
x-friction.closes: Paced request sources with an age on each observation.
